The '''Desert Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas within the [[Kharidian Desert]], such as [[Pollnivneach]], [[Nardah]], and [[Sophanem]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from [[Jarr]] in the [[Shantay Pass]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.
